title: Permit only preregistered partial x2 artifacts during bounded retry
trigger_preconditions: A stopped x2 builder has already written owner-scoped phase runners before a later skill-initialization failure.
failure_signature: The retry preflight allowed only the two builder modules and rejected its own ten preregistered family-current runner files.
candidate_workaround: Allow the exact phase-root, ghc_family_v650_v7 script namespace, evidence builder, and x2 test path while rejecting every other path.
recurrence_guard: Design retry preflights around the declared partial-write surface, never a clean-start-only path set and never an unrestricted repository prefix.
rollback: Give the rejected retry zero execution credit and preserve the already written owner-scoped runner files for bounded inspection.
scope_boundary: Owner-local declared x2 retry state only; no sibling paths, full-suite, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
